_comment: Per installed agentic CLI: the vendor API/auth domains that CLI itself needs reachable to function, distinct from whatever registry installed its binary. patch-firewall-domains.sh merges each entry into devcontainer-firewall's allowed-domains manifest (as '<key>-vendor-api') at postCreateCommand time, if devcontainer-firewall is installed. Skipping an entry here is the single most common way a container ends up fully installed and MCP-wired but unable to serve a single prompt -- see per-cli-mcp-config-checklist.md's own 'Vendor API/auth domains needed' column, which this file is the machine-readable counterpart to.

<other-cli-key>.reason: This CLI's own inference/auth backend -- often more than one host (separate auth, telemetry, or CDN subdomains are common).
